operation.label: Detect unusual counts: EARS C1, C2, C3, CUSUM and EWMA on four series

declaredParameters.ears: C1: the mean and sample standard deviation (n - 1) of the 7 periods before; C2 and C3: of the 7 ending 3 before. Threshold mean + z(1 - alpha) x max(sd, least sd); statistic (x - mean)/sd; a period signals above the threshold. A baseline that does not vary: no statistic, threshold its mean, a count above it signals.
declaredParameters.c3: Over the period and the 2 before, the sum of max(0, C2 statistic - 1), the current period counted (Hutwagner 2003); signals above z(1 - 0.025). Threshold: the count that brings C3 to z, 0 when the 2 before already pass z. No value where any of the three has no statistic.
declaredParameters.cusum: m the mean of the first baselinePeriods; S = max(0, S + (x - m)/sqrt(m) - k) from the first period after; signals where S >= h; threshold the least whole count reaching h from the S before; with reset, S starts again at 0 after a signal. Refused where m is 0.
declaredParameters.ewma: m and sigma (n - 1) of the first baselinePeriods; Z from m, Z = lambda x + (1 - lambda) Z; limit m + L sigma sqrt(lambda/(2 - lambda) (1 - (1 - lambda)^(2i))), i from 1 at the first period watched; signals above the limit. Refused where sigma is 0.
declaredParameters.normalQuantile: Fieldwork's own: an approximation refined against erfc, good to about 1e-7.

series.description: 40 made-up days, five of excess (days 25 to 29): the series Fieldwork's unit test holds to R.
Gastrointestinal visits per day in the syndromic worked example, by the syndrome each visit was generated as; a seeded outbreak 13 to 22 April.

runs.label: the first four weeks as baseline

series.description: Three made-up years of weekly counts, Poisson about 20 + 15 cos(2 pi (week - 2)/52): a winter peak each year.
series.generator: Linear congruential stream (1664525, 1013904223, mod 2^32), seed 20261121; Knuth's Poisson draw.

series.description: A made-up rare condition, about 0.15 a day, with six days at 3 (days 81 to 86).

runs.refused: The baseline's mean is 0, so a count cannot be standardized by it: choose a baseline with cases in it.
The baseline does not vary, so EWMA has no spread to set its limit by: choose a longer baseline.

rReference.source: R 4.4.1, surveillance 1.25.0 (CRAN), run 2026-11-21: earsC(method C1, C2, C3; baseline 7; default alpha) and algo.cusum(range 8:40, k 1.04, h 2.26, trans standard)
